claims.text: Charging your phone overnight ruins the battery.
claims.why: Modern phones slow or pause charging near 100% (Optimized Charging on iPhone, Adaptive Charging on Android). Heat is the real enemy, so don't charge under a pillow.
iOS and Android already freeze apps you aren't using. Force-closing them means a full reload next time, which can use more power. Close an app only when it misbehaves.

claims.text: More megapixels means a better camera.
claims.why: Sensor size, lens quality and image processing matter more. A 12 MP shot from a large sensor often beats a 108 MP shot from a tiny one.

claims.text: You should drain your battery to 0% before recharging.
claims.why: That advice was for old nickel batteries. Lithium-ion batteries wear faster from deep drains; staying roughly between 20% and 80% is gentlest.
On OLED screens, black pixels switch off, so dark mode saves power, especially at high brightness. On LCD screens the backlight stays on, so the saving is tiny.

claims.text: Airplane mode makes your phone charge faster.
claims.why: Switching off the radios lowers power use, so more of the charger's energy goes into the battery. The gain is real but small, often just a few minutes.

claims.text: Incognito mode makes you anonymous online.
claims.why: It only stops the browser saving history and cookies on your device. Websites, your work network and your internet provider can still see what you do.

claims.text: Using a non-original charger damages your phone.
claims.why: Certified chargers from reputable brands are safe. Cheap uncertified ones can overheat or deliver unstable power. Certification matters more than the logo.

claims.text: Your phone needs an antivirus app.
claims.why: iOS and Android keep apps sandboxed, and Android has Google Play Protect built in. Installing updates and only using official app stores protects you more than most antivirus apps.

claims.text: Leaving Bluetooth on drains your battery.
claims.why: Bluetooth Low Energy uses very little power when idle. Switching it off saves almost nothing on a modern phone.
There's no right answer here. The room's vote crowns the winner.
